input: Browser mouse/keyboard at a mobile landscape viewport; touch event behavior checked separately in native fixtures.
scope: Paid skirmishes, resource rally, construction, combat/raid response, protected app update, old-save resume, trade preview and actual Trader recruitment.

baseline.result: Defeat by Town Center destruction at 6:07
baseline.interpretation: Underdefended interaction test with long gaps between actions; not a representative pacing sample.

first_update.observed: Updates showed Update ready, Refresh applied it from the menu, installed version became beta.13, saved solo entry persisted and resumed paused with same bank/army.

trade_planning.near_town: Too near town / Move farther from town
trade_planning.distant_site: Up to 39 gold / trip · clear road needed
trade_planning.assisted_placement: Find space kept the preview and exposed Place Trade Post. The post was purchased and built with normal resources and a worker.
trade_planning.counterplay: Enemy raiders attacked the exposed post while another raid threatened the Barracks. Defenders were redirected and lost.
trade_planning.bug_found: Trader key/button purchased nothing because the building scene lacked its production queue. The existing trade tests directly spawned Traders and missed this. Saved the affected existing post at 5:10 for the fix acceptance test.

final_update.purchase_observation: Clicking the restored post's Trader tile now charged gold from 166 to 126. Wood changed from 385 to 340 while a 15-wood delivery also arrived, consistent with 60 wood charged. No other gold spending or gathering occurred.
final_update.training_outcome: The already badly damaged post was destroyed by raiders before the 22-second training could finish. No Trader birth or delivery is claimed for this browser match; those are verified by the 46-check production and separate route engine fixtures.
final_update.match_end: 5:54 Sacred Site defeat, 2 human army units produced versus 8 AI. Clean return to main menu; completed match save cleared.

limitations: No physical-phone or OS-installed PWA lifecycle test. Browser cache/update/save behavior was observed.
The preview is a geometric upper estimate; actual route reachability is checked by the Trader and blocked or destroyed routes may earn nothing.

Browser acceptance observed the repaired purchase on an old saved post; raiders destroyed it before completion. Actual birth, route start and payout were verified in controlled engine fixtures, not this browser match.
No representative match-duration or prolonged finite-resource-depletion sample in this pass. Rate and cost tuning is unchanged; working recruitment restores the intended trade option.
